story.xio_2_madness.details:
Details: Doctor Eipschwitz, whose head we keep in the storage compartment ofthe Magnum, informed us that at the Fresco Corporation's base of Flat Obsidian, the Telephature Dislocator can be found: a device capable of transporting people into the bramfaturas of planets. We need to ensure the security of the device and load it onto the Shuttle.

Additional Info: On the Flat Obsidian base, there were structures to accommodate PMC Tifton and a phased Venusian temple..

Our analysts were puzzled by how a temple from Venus could end up on Mercury. It turns out that Eipschwitz is a great connoisseur of quasimorphosis. He talks about some "ancient roads" and much more besides. It was there that we first encountered Xiomara and eliminated her following Eipschwitz's lead.

After what happened to Fresco, the base became completely unusable. However, Eipschwitz reports that there's another completely secret laboratory site. Hidden among the rocks, the Telephaturic Dislocator stands right on the surface of Mercury. We just need to land the shuttle nearby, make sure everything is quiet, and retrieve the device.

The Telephaturic Dislocator consumes a lot of energy (that's why Mercury was chosen, an inexhaustible source of heat) to open gates that allow physical objects to transition into the bramfaturas of planets.
story.xio_2_madness.dlg.eipschwitz_see_d: I distinctly remember it standing right here! It was stolen! Those rebels have got their filthy colnodian hands on my property! My very fragile and infinitely valuable equipment! Search the whole damn station, it must be here somewhere. I need i… I mean, we need it!

What?! Barbarians. Vandals. The Dislocator could be perfectly dismantled into four parts! Four! And how many parts are there here? Sixty-two? These idiots have destroyed a masterpiece of human thought! They've pushed all modern science back to the Stone Age! I'll have to start development practically from scratch again. So... I need alloys, microchips, nails... four or eight nails? We need to consider our previous experience... Hmm...
story.xio_2_madness.dlg.jane_see_disloca: I guess the doctor will be incapable of normal human communication for a while. Anyway, let's try to grab anything even remotely resembling a "true work of art" and get you out of there. Looks like colnode reinforcements have arrived, so we'll have to fight our way back again.
story.xio_2_madness.name: Madness Put to Good Use
story.xio_2_madness.objective0: The <color=#FFFEC1>Telephaturiс Dislocator<color=#FFFEC1> is somewhere here. We must get it to the Magnum no matter what.
story.xio_2_madness.objective1: Take the important parts and evacuate
story.xio_2_madness.stage1.name: Flat Obsidian
story.xio_2_madness.stage2.name: TD Playground
story.xio_2_madness.stage3.name: Second Floor
story.xio_2_madness.stage4.name: Third Floor
story.xio_3_bram_ruins.after: Good news: we now have the <color=#FFFEC1>spear</color>. Bad news: <color=#FFFEC1>Mars and its satellites</color>, until now completely free of quasimorphic influence, are now ahead of even Gannix on Venus. This is simultaneously a <color=#FFFEC1>problem</color> for us, for the corporations, and even for </color>Tezctlan<color=#FFFEC1>. They and <color=#FFFEC1>Urparp</color> haven't exactly had the friendliest of relationships. I'd like to ask <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color> some questions, but that's for you to decide, Boss. Mission accomplished.
story.xio_3_bram_ruins.briefing: The station is broadcasting something <color=#FFFEC1>strange</color>. Some prayers, chants, music... Human speech in... <color=#FFFEC1>ancient Sumerian</color>? That doesn't sound like <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color>. The station must be under attack. How fortunate! In the chaos, we can get the shuttle a little closer than we planned. Attack the Sinkhole Oasis and make your way to the <color=#FFFEC1>Monolith</color>. Our task is to destroy it and finally obtain <color=#FFFEC1>Itzpapalotl</color>, the Spear of Tezctlan.
story.xio_3_bram_ruins.details:
Details: Xiomara informed us that in the Sinkhole Oasis, a geological research colony on Mars, we can find an extremely valuable quasimorphic artifact. According to her, we can destroy Tezctlan with its help. If everything is as she says, this weapon will be our trump card in the big game that has begun in the System.

Additional Info: Thanks to Xiomara, we have learned a lot about bramfaturas and quasimorphosis. Xiomara is the Duchess of Gannix, the bramfatura of Venus, who is now at war with her kind. About 1000 years ago, Tezctlan became a hylonaut. This means he went to Earth, and such quasimorphs are no longer capable of escaping our native planet independently. Our analysts report that this happened around the 13th-14th centuries CE. When Tezctlan disappeared from Gannix, Xiomara took power there. With Tezctlan's return, the situation changed for her. Following Dr. Eipschwitz's lead, we drove her and her loyal knights, the Order of Feathered Masks, back to Gannix.

During one of our missions on Venus, Xiomara contacted us again. We made a deal with her and started receiving tasks from her. This helped the Feathered Masks survive in their fight against Tezctlan.

Now Xiomora claims that the Itzpapalotl can be found at the Sinkhole Oasis. When we tried to find out how it got there, the duchess vaguely mentioned an ancient attack on Mars and the murder of its king. Our analysts speculate that this somehow relates to the absence of quasimorphosis on Mars. But before we can unlock all the secrets of the Sinkhole Oasis, we will have to deal with those who currently own it.
story.xio_3_bram_ruins.dlg.jane: I'm making a cautious assumption that our invasion of Sinkhole Oasis triggered some mechanisms similar to what we've seen on Venus before... <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>, I highly doubt that what we are doing will benefit us or humanity.
story.xio_3_bram_ruins.dlg.realware_1: Enthused by the mission of the Blood Warriors, from the beginning we know the Realm of Ur, a realm that lies beyond the boundaries of the physical universe. This is our true fatherland. We know Urparp, guardian of the Bright Throne of Gagtungr. To Him we give the glory that comes from our mouths. We also know the created realm. To it we send our curses. We serve the Conqueror Worm, who bestowed the title of Blood Warriors upon us. From the beginning, we remember Him, the Father of Our Spirit, the Ancient Terror of the Manifested Realm. Enthused by the mission of the Blood Warriors, from the beginning we feel Enkidu, rising through us from the bonds of Creation.
story.xio_3_bram_ruins.dlg.realware_3: Warriors! Our flesh is bound in steel to the will of Lord Urparp! Death to the enemies of our Lord!
story.xio_3_bram_ruins.dlg.urparp_death: I am a god! How can you kill a god? What magnificent, dizzying innocence! How could you be so naive?! My shackled consciousness is now free, my kingdom is awakening with me. The time of war is coming, human.
story.xio_3_bram_ruins.name: Ruins of Ancient Bramfaturas
story.xio_3_bram_ruins.objective0: The spear that killed <color=#FFFEC1>Urparp</color> is still with him.
story.xio_3_bram_ruins.stage1.name: Dock
story.xio_3_bram_ruins.stage2.name: Tech Dock

story.xio_3_bram_ruins.stage4.name: The Dream of a Monster
story.xio_4_nanau.after: Tezctlan's Nakal, Nanauatzin, has been eliminated. However, the war on Venus continues—and the Lady invites us to continue taking part in it, boss.
story.xio_4_nanau.briefing: Nanauatzin is blazing on Magnum's quasimorph sensors. He's brimming with energy. The Lady is on comms—she'll tell you what to do once you're close. This quasimorph... He... He's about to burst from all the gavvakh overfilling him.
story.xio_4_nanau.details:
Details: Nanauatzin is an immobile warden of Tezctlan's gavvakh reserves. Xiomara reports that all the energy Tezctlan allocates to Nanauatzin is used to saturate his durability. There are reports that taltnoms bring people captured on the surface of Venus to him. Apparently, they are used to feed Nanauatzin additional gavvakh.

Additional Info: Itzpapalotl is powerless against Tezctlan while his protection—the three Nakals of Gannix—remains intact. One of them is Nanauatzin—an embodiment of solidity, phased through as the result of a prolonged ritual performed soon after Tezctlan's awakening. Xiomara has reported that Nanauatzin needs not merely gavvakh, but a continuous flow of it. Perhaps the station is holding captives prepared for sacrifices.
story.xio_4_nanau.dlg.captive_killed: I always knew the cause of my death would be either a quasimorph—or a PMC clone.
story.xio_4_nanau.dlg.captive_saved: A voice... in my head... What is this? I'm free. Looks like my mind was inside that stone, phased down there. Thank you! I wasn't expecting help...
story.xio_4_nanau.dlg.captive_stage2_gre: We came to help you! You're an honest, hard-working clone fighting against the quasimorphs. It's our duty to fight by your side.
story.xio_4_nanau.dlg.jane_stage1_greeti: Be careful—biological sensors are picking up living humans on this level. The objective remains the same: push through to Nanauatzin and elimi...
story.xio_4_nanau.dlg.tezctlan_stage2_gr: A grave mistake, mercenary. You and your company have acted foolishly. You chose the wrong side in the war for the Solar System. Xiomara is Gannix's servant. I am its master. You chose to become the servant of a servant. Still, you have a chance to retreat—if your puppet dies here and now.
story.xio_4_nanau.dlg.tezctlan_victory: You've broken one of the pillars of the Emerald Empire. And that... is beautiful. You've seen how pathetic your human life is—how easily it can be put to work for my greatness. Keep going. Every step you take is a new sacrifice for my Emerald Empire. You're not a warrior—you're a priest. You think you serve her, but by repelling your attacks, Gannix will only grow stronger.
story.xio_4_nanau.dlg.xiomara_gavpans_de: Excellent. The gavpans are destroyed. Nanauatzin is vulnerable now. I've dreamed of this for so long. Kill the creature. It will be the first pleasure in a long line of delights I expect to receive from you.
story.xio_4_nanau.dlg.xiomara_stage1_gre: They're sacrifices, bound to Nanauatzin—sources of gavvakh. He's drawing energy from them right now. Find them and destroy them, and it will be easier to deal with this Nakal of Tezctlan.
story.xio_4_nanau.dlg.xiomara_stage1_war: Once you go down to him, there's no turning back. You will either destroy Nanauatzin or die. He is guarded by gavpans, vaults of gavvakh. As long as even one of them remains intact, Nanauatzin's stone flesh is invulnerable to weapons of the physical world.
story.xio_4_nanau.dlg.xiomara_victory: A desperate bluff from a cornered pretender. Ignore it… boss. You can extract the clone—Jane is already standing by. And we have a part to play in Tezctlan's downfall.
story.xio_4_nanau.name: Nanauatzin's Fire
story.xio_4_nanau.objective0: Eliminate Nanauatzin. It's an immobile pyramid on the second floor.
story.xio_4_nanau.objective1: Excellent work. Lady Xiomara is pleased. Evacuation authorized.
story.xio_4_nanau.stage1.name: Abandoned Station
story.xio_4_nanau.stage2.name: Nanauatzin's Lair
story.xio_4_tonatiuh.after: Tezctlan's Nakal, Tonatiuh, has been eliminated. The war among the quasimorphs on Venus continues, boss. Lady Xiomara is calling us to follow her—to keep striking at the Emerald Empire.
story.xio_4_tonatiuh.briefing: Operator deployed to the site of the operation. Seven sources of anomalous energy detected. The geometry of the signatures is distorted, something halfway between a quasimorph and a phased structure. It appears that <color=#FFFEC1>all seven objects are Tonatiuh</color>. To destroy this <color=#FFFEC1>Nakal</color>, all of its parts must be outside the physical world at the same time. <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color> is nearby. She says she'll support us once the operator reaches Tonatiuh.
story.xio_4_tonatiuh.details:
Details: Tonatiuh is one of Tezctlan's three Nakals. This is no ordinary quasimorph. They call him "the laughter of the King of Gannix" because he is nearly impossible to banish from the physical world. He breaks the laws of eccolapse and phasing. Any attempt to destroy him only triggers his rebirth. Xiomara has told us that this Nakal is anchored to the physical side of the bramfatura—the planet Venus. However, the price is high. Tonatiuh has now been split into seven parts. Banishing Tonatiuh demands precise timing, coordination, and luck. No one can do this alone—Xiomara has agreed to support the operation personally.

Additional Info: Nakal Tonatiuh grew from Gannix matter, twisted by Tezctlan's will, at MZ Fresco Platforms. Tonatiuh needs only a small feed of gavvakh—if anything, he acts as a living generator of it. Lady Xiomara says his power is concentrated in three masks of laughter nearby. If you place them into the Casket of Silence—a failsafe Tezctlan created in case Tonatiuh ever slipped his leash—the Nakal's strength will be significantly reduced.
story.xio_4_tonatiuh.dlg.tezctlan_guffaw: How dare you, mercenary? Tonatiuh has been laughing for centuries, and he will laugh long after your wretched humanity is gone. Try to lay a hand on a Mask of the Guffaw, and I will remember your face forever. Believe me, there is no fate worse for a human being.
story.xio_4_tonatiuh.dlg.tezctlan_scream: Stop, mercenary! Whatever that <color=#FFFEC1>deceitful spider-bitch</color> has promised you, I can offer more. You will be a warlord of the armies of the <color=#FFFEC1>Emerald Empire</color> — my priest. But lay hands on that mask, and I will unmake everything you own. Do not test my patience.
story.xio_4_tonatiuh.dlg.tezctlan_snicke: Look into my servant's face, mortal. This isn't laughter, it's the anticipation of laughter—<color=#FFFEC1>Tonatiuh</color>'s snicker when he already knows he has won. Take his mask, if you dare. I will find you and make you snicker until blood mixed with <color=#FFFEC1>gavvakh</color> pours from your throat.
story.xio_4_tonatiuh.dlg.tezctlan_victor: A grave mistake, mercenary. You tore the laughter from a god's throat. But are you ready to hear the sound of the void that remains in its place?
story.xio_4_tonatiuh.dlg.xiomara_guffaws: Don't mind Tezctlan's threats. Once his <color=#FFFEC1>Nakals</color> are destroyed, you'll see a creature trembling with fear instead of the proud ruler of <color=#FFFEC1>Gannix</color>. His mask will be ripped away, just like the one you've just taken from <color=#FFFEC1>Tonatiuh</color>'s servant. Don't forget it. The <color=#FFFEC1>Casket of Silence</color> is somewhere on the second floor.
story.xio_4_tonatiuh.dlg.xiomara_screams: Tezctlan promises worlds and armies, but he always betrays. See for yourself, <color=#FFFEC1>human</color>. His servant has fallen to your clone, and his mask is yours now. Everything Tezctlan promises you, you can get for yourself. With my help.
story.xio_4_tonatiuh.dlg.xiomara_snicker: That's it, <color=#FFFEC1>mercenary</color>. He who laughs last, laughs best. Look at this mask—inside its empty eyes you should catch the glint of our shared victory over the usurper. Keep going. Each mask placed in the <color=#FFFEC1>Casket of Silence</color> will make <color=#FFFEC1>Tonatiuh</color>'s laughter quieter.
story.xio_4_tonatiuh.dlg.xiomara_stage1_: <color=#FFFEC1>Tonatiuh</color>... I’ve always hated him more than the others — those taltnoms still pining for Tezctlan after he turned his back on his own realm — <color=#FFFEC1>Gannix</color>. Do you know what it is to hate for eternity? When the vile laughter crowning your defeat echoes through the eons, repeating again and again. Tonatiuh doesn't know how to die, only how to change faces. Three of his personal barons keep the masks of his laughter. They're somewhere close, I can feel them. If you place the masks into the <color=#FFFEC1>Casket of Silence</color>, it will be easier for you to finish this creature off. Come on, <color=#FFFEC1>mercenary</color>. Make him go quiet. I... I <color=#FFFEC1>like</color> it when you see a plan through.
From here, you can reach the place where Tonatiuh is endlessly reborn in his obelisks. You'll smash him again and again, until there's nothing left of him but... silence.
story.xio_4_tonatiuh.dlg.xiomara_stage2_:
I'm with you, mercenary. Don't let me die—without me, this fight will be impossible. On this floor, Tonatiuh lives and is reborn in your world. Seven paths by which he gathers himself again and again, out of laughter and stone. Break them all at once, and this creature will choke on its own scream. Every part of Tonatiuh must be destroyed simultaneously.

And one more thing... I can feel the Casket of Silence. It's nearby. Place the masks inside, and each one will sever a nerve of his power. Then killing him will be easier. Much easier.
story.xio_4_tonatiuh.dlg.xiomara_victory:
Do you hear it, human? That blessed silence. Let the usurper howl into the void, but I... I can finally breathe. You smothered his laughter, and you did it so easily—like you had your hand around his throat. I like the way you work. Stay close to me a little longer. I'll need someone who knows how to make gods go quiet...

Evacuate the clone, we have much more to do.
story.xio_4_tonatiuh.dlg.jane_xiomara_de: Xiomara has been cast out of the physical world. We should never have allowed this to happen. Evacuation to the Magnum is authorized, but our mission here has failed.
story.xio_4_tonatiuh.name: Tonatiuh's Laugh
story.xio_4_tonatiuh.objective0: Find the obelisks and destroy them simultaneously. Xiomara must not die.
story.xio_4_tonatiuh.stage1.name: Landing Site
story.xio_4_tonatiuh.stage2.name: Tonatiuh's Lair
story.xio_4_topil.after: Topilzin has been eliminated. He was one of Tezctlan's three Nakals. Without destroying them, we can't get to Tezctlan. The war on Venus continues, boss.
story.xio_4_topil.briefing: Attention: according to <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color>, Topilzin's statue is invulnerable to standard attacks. To make the target killable, a voluntary blood offering is required. When you come close to the object, choose a body part and perform an amputation—blood must be spilled at the base of the statue. Only then can Topilzin be destroyed. Manage your strength. Whatever the sacrifice, you'll still have to deal with what comes after the amputation. There are no workarounds. This is the only way.
story.xio_4_topil.details:
Details: Topilzin is one of the three Nakals that uphold Tezctlan's immortality. In the past, he was a priest of Gannix. A loyal servant, he willingly offered to be made into a Nakal as soon as Tezctlan returned. His shell is a statue, frozen in place in Clotho-Node Station. Simple attempts to break it are useless. Topilzin was petrified forever when an unimaginably large surge of gavvakh was driven into him all at once. According to Xiomara, the only way to disrupt this bond is a voluntary blood offering. You don't need to order the clone to kill itself—spilling blood at the foot of the Nakal is enough. That will make him vulnerable. Amputating a limb is a reliable and sufficient method.

Additional Info: The voluntary offering should weaken Topilzin's protection. Gannix is accustomed to violence, but giving blood by one's own will undermines his guard. Don't try to amputate a mechanical limb—you can't cheat the laws of the universe.
story.xio_4_topil.dlg.texctlan_five_left: More effort, mercenary! The closer you die to the victory you crave, the more it will hurt to begin again. And for what? For Xiomara's favor? Five parts of Topilzin are more than enough to snap the thread of your hope.
story.xio_4_topil.dlg.tezctlan_right_sac:
You think you can render me powerless by killing Topilzin? How foolish, mercenary. With me, you could have become a warlord of the armies of the Emerald Empire. Instead you chose to die—and drag your crew down with you. Magnum could have become an aether-ship carrying out my orders. You chose to listen to that lying spider-witch. What did she promise you? Do you really believe she'll give it to you?

Rip him apart, Topilzin. And then I will bring down on him the full might of the Emerald Empire.
story.xio_4_topil.dlg.tezctlan_seven_lef: Excellent. Watching your careful diligence in Xiomara's service is a delight—a diligent, obedient slave. Seven parts of the Nakal are still intact. And they will finish their work.
story.xio_4_topil.dlg.tezctlan_victory: One of the foundations of the Emerald Empire... destroyed by human hands... How beautiful. I have been given fresh proof that the world I am about to conquer deserves a god like me.
story.xio_4_topil.dlg.xiomara_new_task: Topilzin is all of them at once. To destroy the Nakal, you must kill all {0} of them. Do it. Do it! And I will let you lead the Feathered Masks into battle against Tezctlan.
story.xio_4_topil.dlg.xiomara_stage1_gre: I'd gladly spare you this sacrifice. There's nothing sweeter than forcing a captive to bow at the foot of one of Gannix's great idols, then cutting a soft, bared throat. But to kill Topilzin, the offering must be voluntary. Get to that Nakal and <color=#FFFEC1>spill your blood beside him</color>.
story.xio_4_topil.dlg.xiomara_victory:
We're drawing closer and closer to the usurper's throat. Each battle won is a step toward victory. The Emerald Empire will be shattered, and my gratitude will spill into the world as tangible warmth, human.

Extract the clone. We have other work on Venus.
story.xio_4_topil.dlg.xiomara_warning: Topilzin is close. Right at the center of this hall. Don't spill your blood for nothing. Get as close to the statue as you can and do the amputation. Human blood or clone blood, it doesn't matter. Either way, it should be enough to make the Nakal vulnerable.
story.xio_4_topil.dlg.xiomara_wrong: You need to spill blood beside Topilzin's statue. You must anoint the base of his idol with gavvakh.
story.xio_4_topil.dlg.xiomara_wrong_sacr: No. Your mechanical devices won't do. A voluntary offering must be alive, so the gavvakh can flow rich, fresh, and fragrant.
story.xio_4_topil.name: Jump of Topilzin
story.xio_4_topil.objective0: Find Topilzin's statue and amputate a limb beside it.
story.xio_4_topil.objective1:
Destroy all parts of Topilzin.

Parts remaining: {0}/{1}
story.xio_4_topil.objective2:
Extraction authorized.

Topilzin has been eliminated. Another of Tezctlan's Nakal has been removed from the universe without a trace.
story.xio_4_topil.stage1.name: Topilzin Temple
story.xio_5_shattered.after: He's destroyed... at last. Do you feel it too? The emptiness left behind in the universe... and the way it's filling now? You did well, boss. You shattered the Empire, you killed the Emperor. Now there's so much space in your soul. I've always wanted to know what it's like, to take someone's place in someone's soul. Are you ready... boss? Come to me.
